name: Julian
source:
Field of Study: Engineering. 

By a stroke of good luck, you’re getting a new roommate this year. The guy you had to live with last year kind-of sucked. Julian seems like a fairly ordinary guy. He is straight, relatively popular and fairly dependable. Certainly an improvement over the roommate you had last year. Sounds a bit boring, perhaps. Then again, we all have our secrets. What could he be hiding?

[From [url=https://pridedrawing.itch.io/bound-to-college]official site[/url]]
